The '''Hip-mounted cannon''' was a powerful [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Hip-mounted cannon first appeared in the MMORPG [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Clone Wars Adventures]], where players could buy it together wit a Turbolaser and a Republic Grenade Launcher, as part of the Heavy Weapons Set I.
